# package model

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model"
```

Package model defines the typed, normalized representation of IEC 61850 namespace definitions (NSD): namespaces, logical node classes, data objects, common data classes (CDCs), data attributes, constructed attributes, enumerations, functional constraints and presence conditions, together with provenance, diagnostics and the module's error taxonomy.

The types describe the normative class and type model of the standard, not the configuration of a device. A [LogicalNodeClass](#type-logicalnodeclass) lists every data object the namespace defines for the class, including optional ones; whether a device implements them is a question for SCL or discovery.

Values of these types are produced by the nsd package and indexed by the catalog package. Values held by a catalog are shared and must be treated as read-only.

#### Errors {#hdr-Errors}

All packages of the module return errors that wrap the sentinels declared here (ErrInvalidNSD, ErrUnknownLogicalNode, ...), so a single [errors.Is](https://pkg.go.dev/errors#Is) check works across packages. Typed errors ([\*ResolutionError](#type-resolutionerror), [\*AmbiguityError](#type-ambiguityerror), [\*DependencyError](#type-dependencyerror), [\*SourceError](#type-sourceerror), [\*ValidationError](#type-validationerror), [\*ReferenceError](#type-referenceerror)) carry detail for [errors.As](https://pkg.go.dev/errors#As).

### type CommonDataClass

```go
type CommonDataClass struct {
	// Name is the CDC name, e.g. "MV".
	Name string `json:"name"`
	// Variant distinguishes definitions of the same CDC, e.g. SP, SG
	// and SE for the settings CDC SPG. A data object names the CDC
	// only; which variant applies is chosen by the functional
	// constraint of the realization.
	Variant string `json:"variant,omitempty"`
	// SubDataObjects are the sub data objects, e.g. phsA of WYE.
	SubDataObjects []DataObject `json:"subDataObjects,omitempty"`
	// DataAttributes are the data attributes, e.g. mag of MV.
	DataAttributes []DataAttribute `json:"dataAttributes,omitempty"`
	// ServiceParameters are the service parameters of controllable
	// CDCs, e.g. ctlVal.
	ServiceParameters []ServiceParameter `json:"serviceParameters,omitempty"`
	// EnumParameterized reports whether attributes of kind ENUMERATED
	// without a type take the data object's underlying type.
	EnumParameterized bool `json:"enumParameterized,omitempty"`
	// TypeKindParameterized reports whether attributes without a type
	// take the data object's underlying type and type kind.
	TypeKindParameterized bool `json:"typeKindParameterized,omitempty"`
	// Statistics reports whether the CDC supports statistical
	// calculation attributes.
	Statistics bool `json:"statistics,omitempty"`
	// Deprecated marks a CDC kept for compatibility.
	Deprecated bool `json:"deprecated,omitempty"`
	// Informative marks a CDC that is informative only.
	Informative bool `json:"informative,omitempty"`
	Doc         Doc  `json:"doc,omitzero"`
	// Source is the namespace that defines the CDC.
	Source NamespaceID `json:"source"`
}
```

CommonDataClass is a common data class (CDC), e.g. MV, WYE or SPS.

A CDC contains sub data objects (each typed by another CDC) and data attributes. Each slice keeps document order; the Position field of the elements orders the two kinds relative to each other.

### type DependencyError

```go
type DependencyError struct {
	// Namespace is the namespace that declares the dependency.
	Namespace NamespaceID
	// Required is the dependency as declared.
	Required NamespaceID
	// Candidates are loaded namespaces that could satisfy the
	// dependency when the error is an ambiguity, or the selected
	// namespace that conflicts with it.
	Candidates []NamespaceID
	// Reason overrides the default explanation when set.
	Reason string
	// Err is the sentinel this error wraps.
	Err error
}
```

DependencyError reports a namespace dependency that cannot be satisfied.

It unwraps to Err, which is ErrMissingDependency (no loaded release satisfies the dependency) or ErrNamespaceConflict (the profile selects an incompatible release). Catalogs before v0.7.0 also reported several satisfying releases, with ErrAmbiguousReference; they now add the newest.

### type FunctionalConstraint

```go
type FunctionalConstraint string
```

FunctionalConstraint is a two-letter functional constraint, e.g. ST or MX. The string form matches the FunctionalConstraint type of github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850.

```go
const (
	FCST FunctionalConstraint = "ST" // Status information
	FCMX FunctionalConstraint = "MX" // Measurands (analogue values)
	FCSP FunctionalConstraint = "SP" // Setting (outside setting group)
	FCSV FunctionalConstraint = "SV" // Substitution
	FCCF FunctionalConstraint = "CF" // Configuration
	FCDC FunctionalConstraint = "DC" // Description
	FCSG FunctionalConstraint = "SG" // Setting group
	FCSE FunctionalConstraint = "SE" // Setting group editable
	FCSR FunctionalConstraint = "SR" // Service response (service tracking)
	FCOR FunctionalConstraint = "OR" // Operate received
	FCBL FunctionalConstraint = "BL" // Blocking
	FCEX FunctionalConstraint = "EX" // Extended definition (name space)
)
```

Functional constraints. The set a profile actually defines comes from its NSD files; these constants are conveniences.

The ACSI functional constraints are those of IEC 61850-7-2:2010 Table 20, which the 7-2 NSD defines too.

```go
const (
	FCCO FunctionalConstraint = "CO" // Control service parameters
	FCUS FunctionalConstraint = "US" // Unicast sampled value control blocks
	FCMS FunctionalConstraint = "MS" // Multicast sampled value control blocks
	FCRP FunctionalConstraint = "RP" // Unbuffered report control blocks
	FCBR FunctionalConstraint = "BR" // Buffered report control blocks
	FCLG FunctionalConstraint = "LG" // Log control blocks
	FCGO FunctionalConstraint = "GO" // GOOSE control blocks
	FCGS FunctionalConstraint = "GS" // GSSE control blocks
)
```

SCSM functional constraints of the MMS mapping, IEC 61850-8-1:2011 Figure 4 and its NOTE 1: control service parameters and the control blocks, which 7-2 Edition 2 does not list as FCs.

```go
const FCXX FunctionalConstraint = "XX"
```

FCXX is the wildcard functional constraint of IEC 61850-7-2:2010 Table 20, for use in services only. No data attribute has it, and IEC 61850-8-1:2011 does not map it (Figure 4, NOTE 2). It is not [FunctionalConstraint.IsStandard](#func-functionalconstraint-isstandard).

#### func (FunctionalConstraint) IsACSI

```go
func (fc FunctionalConstraint) IsACSI() bool
```

IsACSI reports whether fc is one of the twelve data attribute functional constraints of IEC 61850-7-2:2010 Table 20.

#### func (FunctionalConstraint) IsSCSM

```go
func (fc FunctionalConstraint) IsSCSM() bool
```

IsSCSM reports whether fc is one of the functional constraints that IEC 61850-8-1:2011 Figure 4 adds for the MMS mapping (CO, RP, LG, BR, GO, GS, MS, US).

#### func (FunctionalConstraint) IsStandard

```go
func (fc FunctionalConstraint) IsStandard() bool
```

IsStandard reports whether fc is an ACSI functional constraint ([FunctionalConstraint.IsACSI](#func-functionalconstraint-isacsi)) or an SCSM functional constraint of IEC 61850-8-1 ([FunctionalConstraint.IsSCSM](#func-functionalconstraint-isscsm)). The service-only wildcard FCXX is not.

```go
	// TissuesApplied lists the technical issues applied, when declared.
	TissuesApplied string `json:"tissuesApplied,omitempty"`
	// NamespaceType and AppVersion are declared by some namespaces,
	// e.g. technical reports, verbatim.
	NamespaceType string `json:"namespaceType,omitempty"`
	AppVersion    string `json:"appVersion,omitempty"`
	// NSDVersion is the version of the NSD format the document was
	// written for, e.g. "2017B6" (nsdVersion, nsdRevision, nsdRelease).
	NSDVersion string `json:"nsdVersion,omitempty"`
	// Changes lists the change records of the namespace, in order.
	Changes []NamespaceChange `json:"changes,omitempty"`
	// Copyright is the copyright notice and license the namespace
	// document declares. Redistributed code components must retain it.
	Copyright Copyright `json:"copyright,omitzero"`
	// Doc holds the namespace-level documentation references.
	Doc Doc `json:"doc,omitzero"`

	// Dependencies are the namespaces this namespace depends on, in
	// declaration order.
	Dependencies []NamespaceID `json:"dependencies,omitempty"`
	// DependencyTypes holds the declared dependencyType of a
	// dependency, by dependency standard, verbatim.
	DependencyTypes map[string]string `json:"dependencyTypes,omitempty"`

	BasicTypes            []BasicType               `json:"basicTypes,omitempty"`
	FunctionalConstraints []FunctionalConstraintDef `json:"functionalConstraints,omitempty"`
	TriggerOptions        []TriggerOption           `json:"triggerOptions,omitempty"`
	PresenceConditions    []PresenceConditionDef    `json:"presenceConditions,omitempty"`
	Abbreviations         []Abbreviation            `json:"abbreviations,omitempty"`
	Enumerations          []Enumeration             `json:"enumerations,omitempty"`
	ConstructedAttributes []ConstructedAttribute    `json:"constructedAttributes,omitempty"`
	CDCs                  []CommonDataClass         `json:"cdcs,omitempty"`
	// AbstractLNClasses are the abstract logical node classes that
	// concrete classes inherit from (e.g. DomainLN, StatisticsLN).
	AbstractLNClasses []LogicalNodeClass `json:"abstractLNClasses,omitempty"`
	// LNClasses are the concrete logical node classes (e.g. MMXU).
	LNClasses []LogicalNodeClass `json:"lnClasses,omitempty"`

	// Provenance records where the namespace was loaded from.
	Provenance Provenance `json:"provenance,omitzero"`
}
```

Namespace is one parsed NSD namespace: the normalized content of one NS document. Definitions keep their document order.

A Namespace held by a catalog must be treated as read-only.

#### func (Namespace) BasicType

```go
func (ns *Namespace) BasicType(name string) (*BasicType, bool)
```

BasicType returns the basic type with the given name.

#### func (Namespace) CDC

```go
func (ns *Namespace) CDC(name string) (*CommonDataClass, bool)
```

CDC returns the common data class with the given name. For a CDC defined in variants it returns the first variant; see [Namespace.CDCVariants](#func-namespace-cdcvariants).

#### func (Namespace) CDCVariants

```go
func (ns *Namespace) CDCVariants(name string) []*CommonDataClass
```

CDCVariants returns every definition of the CDC with the given name: one, or one per variant (e.g. SPG for SP, SG and SE).

#### func (Namespace) ConstructedAttribute

```go
func (ns *Namespace) ConstructedAttribute(name string) (*ConstructedAttribute, bool)
```

ConstructedAttribute returns the constructed attribute type with the given name.

#### func (Namespace) Docs

```go
func (ns *Namespace) Docs() []*Doc
```

Docs returns pointers to the documentation of the namespace and of every definition and member in it, in a stable order. Use it to fill or clear documentation texts.

#### func (Namespace) Enumeration

```go
func (ns *Namespace) Enumeration(name string) (*Enumeration, bool)
```

Enumeration returns the enumeration with the given name.

#### func (Namespace) LogicalNodeClass

```go
func (ns *Namespace) LogicalNodeClass(name string) (*LogicalNodeClass, bool)
```

LogicalNodeClass returns the concrete or abstract logical node class with the given name.

#### func (Namespace) Namespaces

```go
func (ns *Namespace) Namespaces() []*Namespace
```

Namespaces returns ns as a one-element slice. It lets a single namespace be passed wherever a source of namespaces is accepted.

#### func (Namespace) Presences

```go
func (ns *Namespace) Presences() []*PresenceCondition
```

Presences returns pointers to the presence conditions of every data object, sub data object, data attribute, service parameter and sub data attribute in the namespace, in a stable order: Presence, then DSPresence for data objects. Use it to fill or clear argument texts (PresenceCondition.ArgsText).

### type NamespaceChange

```go
type NamespaceChange struct {
	Version   string `json:"version,omitempty"`
	Revision  string `json:"revision,omitempty"`
	Release   string `json:"release,omitempty"`
	Tissues   string `json:"tissues,omitempty"`
	ChangesID string `json:"changesID,omitempty"`
	Date      string `json:"date,omitempty"`
}
```

NamespaceChange is a change record of a namespace: the namespace version it refers to and the technical issues it applies.

### type NamespaceID

```go
type NamespaceID struct {
	// Standard is the namespace name, e.g. "IEC 61850-7-4".
	Standard string `json:"standard"`
	// Version is the namespace version year, e.g. "2007".
	Version string `json:"version"`
	// Revision is the namespace revision letter, e.g. "B".
	Revision string `json:"revision"`
	// Release is the namespace release number; 0 when not declared.
	Release int `json:"release,omitempty"`
}
```

NamespaceID identifies one release of an IEC 61850 namespace, as declared by the id, version, revision and release attributes of an NSD document.

The canonical string form is "\<Standard>:\<Version>\<Revision>\<Release>", e.g. "IEC 61850-7-4:2007B5". The release is omitted when zero, e.g. "IEC 61850-7-4:2007B".

#### func ParseNamespaceID

```go
func ParseNamespaceID(s string) (NamespaceID, error)
```

ParseNamespaceID parses the canonical string form produced by [NamespaceID.String](#func-namespaceid-string). A bare standard without ":" yields an ID with only Standard set.

#### func (NamespaceID) Compare

```go
func (id NamespaceID) Compare(other NamespaceID) int
```

Compare orders IDs by standard, version, revision and release. It returns -1, 0 or +1 and gives catalogs a stable order; it does not imply that a higher ID is preferable or compatible.

#### func (NamespaceID) IsZero

```go
func (id NamespaceID) IsZero() bool
```

IsZero reports whether id is the zero value.

#### func (NamespaceID) SameVersion

```go
func (id NamespaceID) SameVersion(other NamespaceID) bool
```

SameVersion reports whether id and other name the same standard, version and revision, ignoring the release.

#### func (NamespaceID) Satisfies

```go
func (id NamespaceID) Satisfies(dep NamespaceID) bool
```

Satisfies reports whether id satisfies a dependency declaration. The standard, version and revision must be equal; a dependency that declares a release is satisfied by that release or a later one, since releases of one version and revision only add corrections.

#### func (NamespaceID) String

```go
func (id NamespaceID) String() string
```

String returns the canonical form, e.g. "IEC 61850-7-4:2007B5".

### type PresenceCondition

```go
type PresenceCondition struct {
	// Name is the condition name, e.g. "M", "O" or "MOcond".
	Name string `json:"name"`
	// Args is the condition argument, verbatim, if any.
	Args string `json:"args,omitempty"`
	// ArgsID references a documentation text for the argument.
	ArgsID string `json:"argsID,omitempty"`
	// ArgsText is the documentation text of ArgsID, e.g. the condition
	// behind MOcond(1). It is filled when an NSDoc file is applied
	// (nsd.ApplyDoc) and empty otherwise.
	ArgsText string `json:"argsText,omitempty"`
}
```

PresenceCondition is the presence condition of a data object or attribute, with its optional argument, e.g. {Name: "M"} or {Name: "AtLeastOne", Args: "1"}.

#### func (PresenceCondition) IsMandatory

```go
func (p PresenceCondition) IsMandatory() bool
```

IsMandatory reports whether the condition is unconditionally mandatory ("M").

#### func (PresenceCondition) IsOptional

```go
func (p PresenceCondition) IsOptional() bool
```

IsOptional reports whether the condition is unconditionally optional ("O").

#### func (PresenceCondition) IsZero

```go
func (p PresenceCondition) IsZero() bool
```

IsZero reports whether no presence condition is set.

#### func (PresenceCondition) String

```go
func (p PresenceCondition) String() string
```

String returns the condition with its argument, e.g. "AtLeastOne(1)".

### type Provenance

```go
type Provenance struct {
```

Provenance records where a namespace was loaded from. It contains metadata only, never source content.

### type ResolutionError

```go
type ResolutionError struct {
	// Namespace is the namespace of the element where resolution
	// stopped, when known.
	Namespace NamespaceID
	// Path is the model path resolved so far, e.g. "MMXU.Hz.mag".
	Path string
	// Element is the name that could not be resolved.
	Element string
	// Expected describes what was expected (a type, an FC), if relevant.
	Expected string
	// Actual describes what was found instead, if relevant.
	Actual string
	// Reason is a human-readable explanation.
	Reason string
	// Err is the sentinel this error wraps.
	Err error
}
```

ResolutionError reports a failure to resolve a model path, such as an unknown data object, an attribute with a different functional constraint or an unresolvable type.

It unwraps to Err, which is one of the package sentinels.

It unwraps to Err, which defaults to ErrInvalidNSD.
